'''Fretch''' was a short-snouted [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] student at the [[Orsis Academy]] who often expressed disdain towards a young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]], thinking him a tattletale and dangerous individual in the academy. After making fun of Maul's "friend" [[Kilindi Matako]] for once being a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], Maul brutally broke Fretch's fingers, after tricking him into participating in a handshake. Skilled in tracking and sharp-shooting, he teamed up with [[Meltch Krakko]] and fellow Rodian [[Hubnutz]] in a combat mission against Maul in the Vale of Pale Tears in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]].

Sporting a [[Mimetic suit/Legends|mimetic suit]], [[Breath mask/Legends|respirator]] mask and a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], Fetch and the other two were defeated after Maul had used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to gain the upper hand.

When Maul was ordered to kill everyone at the [[Orsis Academy]] by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], he personally woke Fretch up before he killed him.
